BL-1105 — Two sessions minting in parallel can claim one ticket id and git will not notice, because the filename carries the slug - both live collisions were caught only by an incidental add/add conflict on a bot-written topic record
What it solves: Reached from the second collision rather than from an operator intake. The
coordinator's merge `51c7547e1` hit the BL-1100 add/add on the topic record,
correctly refused to guess which ticket owned the id, and flagged it in its own
commit message for the specifier. Resolved that instance by renumbe…
Approval context: Firm: the id is chosen by hand and nothing checks it, twice in two days now. The refusal belongs in the gate the specifier already runs on every minted ticket (`specifier_backlog_hygiene_gate.sh`) - that call site exists, so this needs no new one and carries no `required_wiring`.
Your call is the P…
BL-1105 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1105" (or "reject BL-1105 <reason>") to act.
